name: Music Theatre of Connecticut Summer Theatre Programs
description_short: Musical theatre summer programs in Norwalk, CT. One-week half-day or full-day workshops for elementary and middle school students end in a short "show of the week," and a two-week intensive for older students puts on a 1.5-hour musical.
